services.name: Houmas House Mansion and Garden Tour
services.desc: Visit the historic Houmas House Mansion in Darrow, Louisiana. Enjoy expansive gardens, on site restaurants, a full estate tour and a fantastic gift shop! 1 Hour About This historic estate boasts 38 acres of the South’s most beautiful gardens, three restaurants, a luxurious Inn and a historic mansion open daily for tours. The guided mansion tour leads guests through the architectural evolution of the mansion and details how a succession of owners and the Mississippi River grew this manor house to today’s grand estate. Period antiques, artwork and artifacts help the costumed guides All Ages • 1 hour

blurb: Located between Baton Rouge and New Orleans, Louisiana, The Houmas House Estate allows visitors to experience the life of wealthy plantation owners in the 1800’s. The mansion has been restored to the antebellum era, reflecting the opulence and wealth this sugarcane farm boasted in the 1880’s.

quotes.author: Nora F
quotes.text: We visited Houmas house this July, took the tour of the house, strolled through the gardens and had lunch at the restaurant. It was very quiet the day we visited - perhaps because it was the middle of the week - so we had the house tour guide, Ruby - all to ourselves. It was an excellent tour through the house, with lots of history and plenty of time to ask questions. The gardens are beautiful and I believe there is lodging onsite also. We had a delicious lunch too. This was the first of the river plantations we visited and was an interesting example of the sugar baron history in the area

quotes.author: Debbie D
quotes.text: What a lovely afternoon we spent walking around the beautiful gardens then touring the mansion . Our tour guide was a young girl who was very knowledgeable and brought the house to life ( sorry forgotten her name ) . So much to see and the history is incredible . Hard to believe that the owner lives in this mansion . Finished the day with a mint julep very nice indeed .Worth a visit.
